name: Atheena Frizzell
bio: Atheena Frizzell is an American film actress. She's the daughter of filmmaker and actress Augustine Frizzell.

credits.title: Mother Mary
credits.overview: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when iconic pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

credits.title: The Green Knight
credits.overview: An epic fantasy adventure based on the timeless Arthurian legend, The Green Knight tells the story of Sir Gawain, King Arthur's reckless and headstrong nephew, who embarks on a daring quest to confront the eponymous Green Knight, a gigantic emerald-skinned stranger and tester of men.

credits.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
credits.overview: A young journalist in London becomes obsessed with a series of letters she discovers that recounts an intense star-crossed love affair from the 1960s.

credits.title: Light from Light
credits.overview: Shelia, a single mom and sometime paranormal investigator, is enlisted to investigate a possible “haunting” at a widower’s farmhouse in East Tennessee.

credits.title: Ladyworld
credits.overview: After a catastrophic event, eight girls find themselves stranded in a house without electricity. As they run out of food and water, their sanity begins to crumble, and soon they regress to their baser instincts.

credits.title: The Old Man & the Gun
credits.overview: The true story of Forrest Tucker, from his audacious escape from San Quentin at the age of 70 to an unprecedented string of heists that confounded authorities and enchanted the public. credits.title: Never Goin' Back
credits.overview: Angela and Jessie are best friends intent on taking a wild beach trip, but when their roommate loses all of their money in a drug scam, the girls -- blissfully stoned -- go to increasingly daring and absurd lengths to get it back.

credits.title: Bloody Barbara
credits.overview: Barbara is 16 and completely obsessed with horror films. She goes around town covered in fake blood and reenacts the craziest scenes from her favorite films.

credits.title: Krisha
credits.overview: When Krisha returns to her estranged family for Thanksgiving dinner, past demons threaten to ruin the festivities.

credits.title: I Was a Teenage Girl
credits.overview: Emma and Jesse are close friends. One night, after an intense breakup, they have a heartfelt conversation that challenges the boundaries of their friendship in an unexpected way.

credits.title: GBFF
credits.overview: A girl desperately wants her very own gay best friend. She concocts a plan and with the help of her two friends, it goes horribly wrong.
